Package index

All functions

addBMI()
Add Body Mass Index measurement
addCharlsonIndex()
Add Charlson Comorbidity Index (CCI) value based on Charlson et al. (1987) and Charlson et al. (1994) (age-adjusted) version.
addElectronicFrailtyIndex()
Add Electronic Frailty Index (eFI) value based Clegg et al. (2016) definition
addElectronicFrailtyIndex2()
Add Electronic Frailty Index 2 (eFI2) value based on Best et al. (2025)
addEthnicity()
Add the ethnicity of a person to a table
addHospitalFrailtyRiskScore()
Add the hospital frailty risk score as defined in Gilbert et al: https://doi.org/10.1016/S0140-6736(18)30668-8
addIndexOfMultipleDeprivation()
Add Socio-economic status as a column to a table using the Index of Multiple Deprivation
addLocation()
Add the location to a table
addPolypharmacyCount()
Add the maximum number of ingredients an individual is exposed simultaneously in a certain window.
addSocioEconomicStatus()
Add Socio-economic status as a column to a table
addTownsend()
Add Socio-economic status as a column to a table using the Townsend deprivation index
addUpdatedCharlsonIndex()
Add Updated Charlson Comorbidity Index (CCI) value based on Quan et al. (2011)
getIndexCodelist()
Get the codelists used for a certain index calculation
